frames.caption: SET AND BRACE 1/6
frames.cue: Brace with the bar over midfoot and arms straight.

frames.caption: LIFT FROM FLOOR 2/6
frames.cue: Push through the floor; raise hips and chest together.

frames.caption: PASS THE KNEES 3/6
frames.cue: Keep the bar close as you extend your hips.

frames.caption: STAND TALL 4/6
frames.cue: Stand tall without leaning back or shrugging.

frames.caption: HINGE TO LOWER 5/6
frames.cue: Send hips back and keep the bar close.

frames.caption: CONTROLLED RETURN 6/6
frames.cue: Bend knees as the bar passes them; lower under control.
